critical_numerical_finding.statement: Inverting the staged artifact's header offset through the project's OWN certified CRS does not yield Ingolstadt. It yields a location ~164 km away. The staged frame and the certified CRS are mutually inconsistent.

computation.result_location_appears_to_be: Bavaria/Czech border area near 49.19N 13.57E, not Ingolstadt (48.77N 11.43E)

forward_check.description: Projecting true Ingolstadt (48.766, 11.425) through the same certified CRS

extent_cross_check.interpretation: The N extent nearly matches the OSM north-south span (ratio 0.974) and the E extent is in the same ballpark (0.854), so the staged XODR plausibly covers the right physical area. That means the AREA is right while the absolute PROJECTED FRAME is wrong - consistent with a frame/CRS offset rather than wrong content.

why_no_crs_can_be_supplied.statement: Every candidate CRS was tested and none reconciles the staged offset with Ingolstadt. Supplying any of them would move the error rather than fix it.
why_no_crs_can_be_supplied.conclusion: The staged frame is offset by roughly (-154 km E, -54 km N) relative to true Ingolstadt under the certified CRS. No tested projection closes a gap of that shape. Reverse-engineering a projection to fit would be curve-fitting to a single point and is explicitly out of bounds.

lat0_convention_defect_confirmed.finding: Even a perfectly emitted projection string does not give CARLA the right answer, because CARLA reads +lat_0 as if it were the map's geographic latitude.

evidence.consequence: CARLA would place the map at latitude 0 (the equator) instead of 48.766N. Gauss-Krueger and UTM strings universally carry +lat_0=0 because the projection's latitude of origin is the equator, not the map's location.
evidence.implication: The preferred-fix hierarchy item 'make OSM2ODR emit the complete authoritative tmerc definition' is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT. A CARLA-consumable georeference must carry the map's true geographic origin, which no standard proj4 string expresses as lat_0/lon_0 in the way CARLA reads them.

lat0_convention_defect_confirmed.consequence_for_the_emitter_fix: OSM2ODR must additionally emit the true geographic origin in a form CARLA reads. CARLA's parser reads +lat_0/+lon_0, so those two keys must carry the MAP's geolocation, which conflicts with their proj4 meaning. This is a CARLA-side convention bug, not an OSM2ODR bug, and the fix must be coordinated rather than applied blindly to one side.
